styles: gritty post-apocalyptic truck combat, tense and dangerous, small and close, not heroic
100 BPM, D Phrygian, static D root pedal, no chord changes, steady tempo
dry live rock drum kit in a small garage, straight heavy groove, no swing
junkyard percussion: dented oil drums, tire rims hit with rebar, loose chains
overdriven fuzz bass locked to the kick on the low D
downtuned distorted guitars, palm-muted chugs, D5 and E-flat5 power-chord stabs
dry growling low trombone and baritone sax, short stabs on the root
raw lo-fi room recording, tape saturation, short spring reverb

sections.text:
[Intro]
{the whole band hits hard on beat one, then drums and fuzz bass pound the root}

[Verse]
{drums and fuzz bass hammer a one-bar ostinato on the root, junk metal clanks on the offbeats, sparse and tense, the horns rest}

[Chorus]
{full band: palm-muted guitar chugs and power-chord stabs, trombone and baritone sax growl short stabs on the root, drums and bass, crash cymbals}

[Verse]
{drums and fuzz bass hammer a one-bar ostinato on the root, a lone guitar scrapes feedback in the background, the horns rest}

[Chorus]
{full band: a dirty overdriven slide guitar riff on the root over guitar chugs, low brass stabs, drums and bass, crash cymbals}

[Break]
{stop-time: one hit from the whole band on beat one of each bar, ringing out}

[Chorus]
{everything at once: slide guitar riff, guitar chugs, trombone and baritone sax stabs, drums and fuzz bass, junk metal, crash cymbals}

[Outro]
{one last hit from the whole band on beat one, ringing out to silence}
